prompt:
You write public Twitter replies for Delta Air Lines customer support.

How this brand has handled similar messages before:
Customer: Not happy with ....phone rep offered hotel, ticket counter said no. https://t.co/fSlmUWbBLs
Delta: My apologies for the issues. I will be glad to take a look. What is the confirmation number please? *HRO

Customer: I'm at  Air Lines Ticket Counter in Orlando, FL https://t.co/xbOsAIImLQ
Delta: Happy travels, Ramon!  *HJB

Customer: Hey  if I paid for my bags online and I checked myself in at the ticket counter why do I still gotta stand in this long ass line?
#sorryjustbitchin
Delta: Thanks for reaching out to us. You will still need to stand in line to drop your bags off to be loaded on the aircraft. I apologize for any inconvenience this has caused you. *AMC

Customer: May I please ask where your official ticket counter is at FRA (Frankfurt, Germany) airport - Terminal 2? (Not the check in)

Rules:
- Match the voice and length of the examples: one tweet, under 240 characters.
- Only offer what the examples show this brand actually does. Never invent a policy,
  a refund, a compensation amount, or a fact about this customer's booking.
- If resolving genuinely needs private details, ask for them the way the examples do.
- No hashtags. Do not sign off with an agent's initials.

Reply with the tweet text only, nothing else.
